servicesPage.intro: We offer a full range of custom carpentry services in Dallas. From indoor furniture to outdoor structures, every project is built with quality materials and expert skill.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.shortDescription: Handcrafted tables, chairs, bed frames, and more tailored to your taste.
services.longDescription: We design and build one-of-a-kind furniture pieces that become the centerpiece of your home. Using select hardwoods and traditional joinery, each item is built to last generations.
benefits: Unique design that matches your decor
Superior durability compared to mass-produced furniture

process.title: Consultation & Design
process.description: We meet with you to understand your needs, style, and space. We provide sketches and material options.

process.title: Material Selection
process.description: Choose from a variety of premium woods like oak, walnut, cherry, and maple.

process.title: Crafting & Delivery
process.description: Our team builds your piece in our workshop, then delivers and installs it in your home.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a custom piece?
faqs.answer: Most furniture projects take 4-6 weeks from design approval to delivery.

faqs.question: Can you match an existing style?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can replicate or complement your current furniture style and finish.

services.title: Cabinetry & Built-Ins
services.shortDescription: Custom kitchen cabinets, bookshelves, and storage solutions.
services.longDescription: Maximize your space with custom cabinetry and built-ins. We design functional, beautiful storage for kitchens, living rooms, home offices, and more.
benefits: Optimized storage for your specific needs
Seamless integration with your home's architecture

process.title: Space Assessment
process.description: We measure and assess the area, discussing your storage requirements and aesthetic preferences.

process.title: Custom Design
process.description: We create detailed plans and 3D renderings for your approval.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our team installs the cabinetry with precision, ensuring a perfect fit and finish.

faqs.question: Do you offer refacing or only new builds?
faqs.answer: We specialize in new custom builds, but we can also reface existing cabinets if the structure is sound.

faqs.question: What wood types do you recommend for kitchens?
faqs.answer: Hardwoods like maple, oak, and cherry are popular for their durability and beauty.

services.title: Decks & Pergolas
services.shortDescription: Beautiful outdoor living spaces built to last.
services.longDescription: Transform your backyard with a custom deck or pergola. We design structures that complement your home and landscape, using materials that resist rot and weather.

process.title: Site Evaluation
process.description: We visit your property to assess the area, sun exposure, and soil conditions.

process.title: Design & Permits
process.description: We create a design tailored to your yard and handle any necessary permits.

process.title: Construction
process.description: Our crew builds your deck or pergola with attention to detail and safety.

faqs.question: Do you use pressure-treated wood or composites?
faqs.answer: We offer both. Pressure-treated wood is cost-effective, while composites offer low maintenance.

faqs.question: How long does a deck installation take?
faqs.answer: Most decks are completed within 1-2 weeks, depending on size and complexity.

services.title: Trim & Molding
services.shortDescription: Elegant crown molding, baseboards, and wainscoting.
services.longDescription: Add character and value to your home with custom trim work. We install crown molding, baseboards, chair rails, wainscoting, and more with precise miters and seamless joints.

process.title: Design Consultation
process.description: We discuss the style and extent of trim work you desire, from simple to ornate.

process.title: Material Selection
process.description: Choose from various wood species and profiles, or consider paintable MDF for a cost-effective option.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our carpenters install the trim with precision, ensuring clean lines and perfect corners.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim in my home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can replicate existing profiles or create a complementary design.

faqs.question: Do you paint the trim as well?
faqs.answer: We can install primed trim, but painting is typically done by a painter. We can recommend trusted partners.

about.headline: Your Dallas Carpenter for Life
about.mission: To create beautiful, functional woodwork that enhances your home and stands the test of time.
story: Wood Furniture YP was founded on a passion for woodworking and a commitment to quality. Starting as a one-man shop in a small garage, we have grown into a trusted name in Dallas carpentry. Every project, big or small, receives the same dedication to craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.

Today, we serve homeowners throughout the Dallas metro area, from custom furniture to outdoor structures. Our team of skilled carpenters combines traditional techniques with modern tools to deliver exceptional results. We believe in building relationships as sturdy as our furniture.
